  | name                     = Scarab of Protection
  | type                     = Trinket
  | basevalue                = 400 pp
  | weight                   = 0.10 lbs
  | slot                     = Trinket
  | quest                    = Random
  | chest                    = level ~10-17 chests/rewards
  | durability               = 10
  | material                 = Gold
  | hardness                 = 2
  | minlevel                 = 0
  | bind                     = {{Bind|no}}
  | mythic                   = no
  | enhancements             = 
* {{Spell Resistance|20}}
* {{Absorption|Scarab of Protection Ward|0|12}} 
  | description              = The scarab's possessor gains 20 spell resistance. The scarab absorbs energy-draining attacks, death effects and negative energy effects. Upon absorbing 12 such attacks, the scarab turns to powder and is destroyed.
  | pic                      = Trinket Generic Scarab.png
  | picdesc                  = Scarab of Protection.png
  | tips                     = 
*Destroyed upon losing it's final charge.
*Very useful for low level characters, as it has no minimum level and SR20 is very effective in level 1-5 quests.
*This Scarab is also a useful one-shot protector for characters from most [[beholder]] effects who must endure attacks from more than one of these magic-robbing Outsiders in quests such as [[Invaders!]] and [[The Jungle of Khyber]].
}}

enchantments.text: Scarab of Protection Ward - 12 Charges, No Recharges
